defaults.evidence: These four precise existing foods already have approved exact pantry/market links. Add explicit counterpart records with the reviewed global title policy; this does not turn the IDs into mixed groups, create substitutions or change exact pantry ownership.
defaults.prices: Qualify original offers before scoring and per-store selection, including direct/cached recipe repricing. Preserve selected-store pools and history. No new fixed price or yield conversion.

decisions.rationale: Original offer must name Hass and avocado, representing fresh unprepared fruit. Size, bag, generic avocado, place of origin or brand is not variety evidence.

Original offer must identify chicken breast, boneless AND skinless, plus raw/uncooked/unprepared or cook-before-eating evidence. Chilled and frozen raw unprepared breast are the same reviewed identity; thaw frozen raw chicken in the refrigerator before these recipes.
Original offer must identify fresh unprepared green cabbage. Whole or plainly cut/shredded raw green cabbage is the same food; retain the observed retail unit without a new yield conversion.

Original offer must explicitly identify fresh unprepared sweet potato or sweetpotato. A single label such as Garnet yams (sweet potatoes) can establish sweet potato only because it explicitly names it; a bare yam or Garnet-yam title cannot. No new yam alias or true-yam ingredient is proposed.
